name: SatyaCheck
description: Chrome extension with a 7-layer AI pipeline that detects misinformation in real time using fine-tuned LLMs and ensemble NLP models — 92.6% detection accuracy.
longDescription: SatyaCheck is a browser extension that analyses web content in real time and flags potential misinformation. It chains seven analysis layers — from source credibility and claim extraction to fine-tuned LLM classification and ensemble NLP scoring — to reach 92.6% detection accuracy.

name: Real-Time Bus Tracker
description: Live city-bus positioning system with sub-second WebSocket updates, interactive Leaflet.js maps and a Spring Boot REST backend.
longDescription: A real-time bus tracking system built with Node.js, Express and Socket.IO on the backend, Leaflet.js for interactive maps and vanilla JavaScript on the frontend. Features live bus location updates, route visualisation, speed control and user location tracking over REST APIs and WebSockets.

name: Hand Sign Detection
description: Real-time ASL alphabet recognition from webcam streams using MediaPipe landmarks and a custom PyTorch CNN.
longDescription: A computer-vision system that recognises American Sign Language alphabet gestures in real time. Uses MediaPipe for hand-landmark detection and a custom PyTorch CNN trained on augmented gesture datasets, with OpenCV handling the webcam pipeline.
highlights: Custom CNN trained on augmented data

name: Premium Portfolio Website
description: This site — Next.js 14 portfolio with a Three.js particle hero, scroll-linked animations, liquid-glass UI and a Nodemailer contact pipeline.
longDescription: A dark, minimal portfolio built with Next.js 14 and Tailwind CSS. Features a 24k-particle Three.js woven-light hero, Framer Motion scroll animations, spotlight project cards, GitHub API integration and real email delivery via Nodemailer.
